decisions.reason: Because it remained marketed through 2024 and likely fits the firm's established spraying portfolio, management would keep the option open while the cost of carrying it appears modest and no clear failure signal is visible.

Its dedicated product page and evidence of prior field testing suggest a more committed launch with uncertainty already reduced, so the expected value of staying in the market still outweighs abandonment.
The use of proven WIWA air motors lowers technical uncertainty and carrying cost, so this looks like a low-risk extension that is worth keeping while demand continues to be tested.
Although somewhat more adjacent to the core equipment business, its continued standalone presentation indicates enough strategic interest to preserve the option until market feedback becomes clearer.
As the newest launch with little outcome information yet, it is too early to infer low value, and real-options logic favors keeping it on the market until uncertainty resolves further.
